title: Aromatic Indian Lentils Dal Tadka
description: Savory and juicy Indian lentil dish featuring yogurt, perfect for a brunch mood, with anti-inflammatory properties. This dal tadka is a comforting and flavorful meal.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and drain well, then set aside.
Heat the ghee or oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the turmeric, salt, and rinsed lentils, stirring well to combine.
Add the water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Use a pressure cooker to cook the lentils for 10 minutes, if desired, for faster cooking.
Stir in the plain yogurt and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the dal tadka hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
